comments.body:
Pet acquired from Black sea once winning a sea battle.
+2 art trading, has an effect: persuasive skill enhancement.

Part of the 'Footsteps with Friends (no.2) memorial album.

The completion of the MA grants:
'First-Class Merchant's Training Techniques'
+2 Pet Training, +1 Accounts, +1 Livestock Trading.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
To continue on MarcoS' original post... This item is part of the Footprints with Friends (No.2) Memorial Album. It can only be found by Pets in specific land and sea zones, and does not appear even in charted landing zone item lists.

If you wish to hunt it out for your MA, your best chance of finding it is to acquire both the Pet Training skill and a pet that has Area Search (Land) or Area Search (Sea), then spam Procurement/Collection; Additional Discovery and Pet Plunder (Land and/or Sea) can also work, but potentially at much a lower probability rate. Visit the Pet Training skill page for further details and links to some handy pet guides under the comment section.

I'm not sure about ocean zones (besides the Black Sea of course), but according to a JP blog you can find this particular Pet MA item using a Pet with Area Search (Land) skill at the following landing points:

· Scandinavia West Coast
· Atlantic Ocean Central West Coast

Hope that helps. Cheers.
